scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && esbuild src/oauth-client.ts --bundle --format=iife --global-name=GlowOAuth --outfile=dist/public/oauth-client.js && esbuild src/web-client.ts --bundle --format=iife --global-name=GlowWeb --outfile=dist/public/web-client.js && node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.mkdirSync('dist/public',{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync('public/index.html','dist/public/index.html')"
